title: Smoked Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavor-packed dish from North Africa, featuring tender lamb in a smoky spice blend. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the lamb against the grain for tender results

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the kebabs during cooking

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: Adds a deep smoky flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of spices commonly used in North African cuisine

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: To enhance the flavors of the lamb

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: To add depth to the dish

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, or heat a grill pan to the same temperature.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, smoked paprika, Algerian spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the spice mixture evenly onto both sides of the lamb cubes.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
Let the kebabs rest for 2-3 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
If cooking indoors, make sure to use a meat thermometer to ensure the lamb reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the kebabs cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Reheat the kebabs in a pan or under the broiler before serving.
